title: Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements Receivables Terms Card
content:
Payment, late-fee, suspension and refund figures for agreement charges under each tier of the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Tier | Payment terms (calendar days after posting) | Late fee per monthly fee period (percent) | Minimum late fee per period | Grace days after due date | Days past due before suspension | Reinstatement fee | Card payments accepted | Card surcharge (percent) | Refund processing (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ready Profile Service Agreement | 30 | 1.5 | 0.00 | 10 | 0 | 0.00 | Yes | 2.95 | 10 |
| Silver Priority Service Agreement | 30 | 1.5 | 25.00 | 10 | 45 | 75.00 | Yes | 2.95 | 10 |
| Gold Priority Service Agreement | 30 | 1.5 | 25.00 | 10 | 45 | 75.00 | Yes | 2.95 | 10 |
| Platinum Priority Service Agreement | 30 | 1.5 | 25.00 | 10 | 60 | 100.00 | Yes | 2.95 | 10 |
| Portfolio Master Service Agreement | 45 | 1.0 | 50.00 | 15 | 75 | 250.00 | No | 2.95 | 10 |
| Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement | 30 | 0.0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | No | 0.0 | 10 |

## Card notes

- **Payment terms**: calendar days after an agreement charge posts by which it is due.
- **Late fee per monthly fee period**: the late fee on past-due agreement charges per monthly fee period, in percent.
- **Minimum late fee**: the minimum late fee per monthly fee period.
- **Grace days**: grace days after the due date before a late fee may post, in calendar days.
- **Days past due before suspension**: calendar days an agreement charge may be past due before the agreement is suspended.
- **Reinstatement fee**: the fee to reinstate a suspended agreement.
- **Card payments accepted**: whether agreement charges may be paid by card.
- **Card surcharge**: the surcharge on agreement payments made by credit card, in percent.
- **Refund processing**: business days (Monday to Friday, excluding company holidays) to issue a refund of an agreement credit balance.

## Differences between tiers

- The Portfolio Master Service Agreement has the longest payment terms (45 days) and grace (15 days), a 1.0 percent monthly late fee with a 50.00 minimum, and does not accept card payments.
- Card payments are accepted at the Ready Profile, Silver Priority, Gold Priority and Platinum Priority tiers, each with a 2.95 percent surcharge; the Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement accepts no cards.
- Refunds of a credit balance take 10 business days at every tier.
